about: An answer read from a landed cone is a judgment like a take: it pays a demand only where a take would have, a view by its leaf and anything else with a case in its cone.
A demand whose cone holds no sample and no vector is not paid by reading that its leaves are vouched: vouched is not judged.

cases.name: a law whose cone holds only code, read from a landed cone
a view whose leaf is vouched, read from a landed cone
a law whose cone holds its sample, read from a landed cone

red was: an accept vouched digests.ts and verb.ts for another demand, and two demands for eras that were never built were answered from the landed cone and read as paid
